notes: Adds a final Entry Requirements quick reference for the Sep/Oct 2026 trip. Current official guidance confirms U.S. ordinary-passport holders do not need tourist visas for Türkiye or the Schengen countries on this itinerary; Schengen passports must be valid at least 3 months beyond the Oct. 6 Schengen departure and issued within the previous 10 years. TEE uses a conservative Apr. 2, 2027 passport-expiry target because U.S. guidance recommends 6 months and current Switzerland guidance is stricter. EES is fully operational but requires no advance application; ETIAS is not yet in operation and is not required for this trip. The page is available under Quick Reference and is cached offline. No protected passport values are exposed.
